question: What is the primary purpose of the knowledge base within a Claude Project?
options: A) It gives Claude uploaded documents, text, and code as shared context for every chat inside the project
B) It automatically publishes any uploaded files to other users outside of the project boundary
C) It converts each uploaded file into a separate standalone chatbot scoped to that project alone
D) It stores a running log of every prompt a user has typed across all of their separate projects
correct_answers: A) It gives Claude uploaded documents, text, and code as shared context for every chat inside the project
explanations: Correct. The project knowledge base holds documents, text, code, and other files that Claude uses as background context across all chats within that project.
Incorrect. Files uploaded to a project's knowledge base are not automatically published outside the project; access depends on project sharing settings.
Incorrect. The knowledge base supplies context to Claude within the project; it does not spin up a separate chatbot.
Incorrect. The knowledge base is not a prompt history log; it is a repository of uploaded reference material scoped to one project.
